Dungeon Crawler Carl trading cards: Series 1 cards and packs

2026-10-20 · Updated 2026-10-30

Looking for Dungeon Crawler Carl trading cards? Playmates announced a collectible-card release, and retailers list Series 1 packs. The separate Unstoppable deck-building game is for play. Check which product you mean before looking for a card list, a seller or a price.

Which Dungeon Crawler Carl cards are being sold?

  • Collectible trading cards. Playmates Toys announced a Dungeon Crawler Carl trading-card rollout with Books-A-Million. Hot Topic lists a Series 1 trading-card pack. Check the issuer and packaging before assuming that cards from different sellers belong to the same release.
  • Unstoppable game cards. Renegade Game Studios describes Unstoppable as a card-crafting deck-building game. Its playable cards are not a checklist for the collectible trading-card release.

Is there a Dungeon Crawler Carl Series 1 card list?

As of October 30, 2026, we have not verified a card-by-card checklist from the Series 1 issuer. CardBox shows a third-party Series One checklist with 100 cards documented. Use it to look up card names and numbers, but do not treat it as an issuer checklist or a verified price guide. Its catalog showed no cards with a value when checked.

For a card you have opened, look for the issuer, release name, printed number, character, artwork and any foil or limited marking. A character name alone cannot confirm the printing.

Where can you buy Dungeon Crawler Carl trading cards?

Hot Topic's Series 1 pack listing was out of stock when checked on October 30, 2026. Check its current availability and shipping region before ordering. Playmates also announced a rollout with Books-A-Million; that announcement does not confirm current stock at a particular store. Card AI does not sell these packs.

Check the card before checking value

Keep a loose single separate from a sealed pack. Compare the card's visible details with the release you identified before using a price.

Card AI suggests catalog matches for supported physical cards. A Dungeon Crawler Carl card is not guaranteed to have a matching record or price. If a suggested result does not match the release and visible variant, do not save another printing as a substitute. Card AI does not authenticate a card, predict a grade or guarantee a sale price.
